title: Lizard Meme Sound Pack [Superb Warfare]
description: A small client-side resource pack that replaces the Superb Warfare defence tower sound with a fun lizard meme–style audio
body:
This client-side resource pack replaces the defence tower sound from the Superb Warfare mod with a fun lizard meme–style audio. It is designed purely for humor and does not modify, redistribute, or bundle any files from the original mod. The pack works by overriding sound playback locally using Minecraft’s resource pack system. 

[The Superb Warfare mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/superb-warfare) must be installed for this pack to have any effect. This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by the original mod authors.
